description: A question and its answer in the "People often ask" section of the modern layout of the business page. A page holds at most 5 questions, and the modern layout shows all of them.

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns the question (e.g., "ea0tpkm5j3q86uaa").

business_page_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business page that shows the question (e.g., "k2xw9q4m7zt1h8ba").

question.description: The question, as plain text. Spaces at the start and the end are removed, and an empty question is refused. For a business that may not send links, a text that looks like a link is refused (e.g., "Do you take walk-ins?").

answer.description:
The answer, as HTML. The server removes scripts, event handlers and tags that are not allowed before it stores the answer, and refuses an answer that is empty after that. For a business that may not send links, a text that looks like a link is refused (e.g., "

Yes, from 9 am to noon.

").

position.description: Zero-based place of the question in the list. In an update, the question moves to this place and the server shifts the other questions (e.g., 0, 1, 2).

created_at.description: Time when the question was created (e.g., "2026-11-27T10:30:00Z").

updated_at.description: Time of the last change. Send this value back in an update to detect a conflicting change (e.g., "2026-11-27T10:30:00Z").
